verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Milvus publishes an llms.txt at https://milvus.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200), with proper llms.txt-style content describing the product, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The MCP server evidence belongs to a separate story and is not credited here. Missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt's depth and coverage (e.g. links to the full docs or an llms-full.txt variant), first-party documentation describing agent-oriented docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://milvus.io/llms.txt # Milvus
